claims.claim: Buy and drive nothing to fix

risks.risk: The frame may have cracks or significant rust that is not visible in the wide-angle photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints and the underside of the bike.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike being pedaled to confirm the drivetrain and brakes work.
Close-up photos of the frame to check for cracks or rust.
response.reason: The item is clearly a bicycle. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of condition is provided.
